notes: Rule 11: the report rests on a cited book, «وجدته في كتاب كان كتبه أيوب بن موسى»; its writer Ayyub is read as a link from the book's own chain (Zuhri, Urwa, Aisha). Doubt: whether Ayyub is a transmitter or only the book's author.
Zuhri in the scene («فصاح بي») is not a link; Sufyan's own account is the second link.
